response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and cross-domain experience, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical gap for a client-facing role requiring C1 proficiency.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across diverse tech stacks and domains
Strong track record of mentoring and creating educational content (workshops, courses)
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of architectural leadership or UML modeling in past roles
Lacks documented experience managing teams or overseeing multiple client projects
